create_atom_with_symbol: create an Atom instance with an element symbol and coordinates in bohr
create_atom_with_angstrom: create an Atom instance with coordinates in angstrom that auto converts to bohr
get_atom_coords_array: get a numpy array of atomic coordinates in bohr from an Atom instance
get_atom_coords_angstrom: get atomic coordinates converted to angstrom from an Atom instance
convert_pyscf_mol_to_config: convert a PySCF Mole object to an internal ConfigDict representation
